description.value: A family-owned bike shop in Mission's historic Railway Avenue district, operating continuously since 1978 when the Wenting family purchased the original Planet Earth Cycles. Now occupying 5,200 square feet with 10 staff, the shop carries road, mountain, hybrid, e-bikes, and kids' bikes alongside accessories, GPS computers, clothing, and bike racks. Jerseys from Canadian cycling champions hang on the walls, reflecting deep roots in the local cycling community.

address.value: 33245 North Railway Avenue, Mission, BC, V2V 1E4

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (7 spaces) at 27m; stands (2 spaces) at 56m; stands (2 spaces) at 67m. Total: 11 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms this is a full-service bike shop operating since 1978 in Mission, BC. The services page lists tune-ups, overhauls, flat repairs, and e-bike diagnostics, confirming staff help with mechanicals and walk-in repair capability. E-bike service is confirmed via explicit e-bike diagnostic and service pricing on the services page. No mention of pump availability, bike rentals, bike boxes, shipping, shuttle services, guided rides, DIY stand, washrooms, water refill, or charging on the website. Contact info (phone 604-826-1411, address 33245 North Railway Avenue, Mission, BC V2V 1E4, website wentingscycle.com) all match between OSM and website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established full-service bike shop with nearly 50 years of operation, offering repairs, parts, accessories, and e-bike service — a clear resource for touring cyclists passing through Mission.

E-bike service.detail: E-bike overhaul listed at separate pricing; e-bike diagnostics offered at hourly shop rate; DH/E-Bike tire/tube services listed
